# ADR-051 — Checkpoint 6.7 seven-day pre-deployment token-longevity gate waived by owner; OAuth In production before deploy; longevity deferred to monitoring

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

**Checkpoint 6.7 acceptance amended by the project owner (2026-08-28): the mandatory seven-day pre-deployment token-longevity gate is superseded.** The existing OAuth application (project `personal-os-196cf`, the existing Web client) was published Testing -> **In production** — the only mutations being the publish itself and the two consent-screen display URLs Google's new console requires (homepage and privacy-policy, both `https://personal-os.tail62a68f.ts.net` under the already-authorized domain; owner-approved). No second development OAuth application, client, project, account or credential set exists or may be used. **OAuth must be In production before deployment; immediate post-publishing authorization plus a bounded synchronization remain mandatory** and were verified the same day (same connection row reused, history preserved, one-stream manual pass succeeded, a real forced refresh grant succeeded). **Seven-day longevity is not claimed as passed**: it is accepted for deployment and moved to post-deployment monitoring, and any later `invalid_grant`, unexpected reauthorization or credential failure on this connection is a production incident. Status labels: pre-deployment wait `waived_by_owner` · immediate production-mode proof `verified` · seven-day longevity `deferred_post_deployment` (user-approved 2026-08-28) **[Present state corrected by ADR-057.]**
